title: Change ending text from 'always dithering and slytherin' to 'ravenclaw and slytherin for life'

requirements.summary: Replace ending text 'always dithering and slytherin' with 'ravenclaw and slytherin for life' in the MainCard component
acceptanceCriteria: The text 'always dithering and slytherin' no longer appears anywhere in the rendered UI.
The text 'ravenclaw and slytherin for life' appears at the end of the main page message in its place.
The new text is styled consistently with the existing Slytherin/Harry Potter magical theme and typography.
No other text or layout is changed.

file_operations.description: Locate the MainCard component rendering the ending text 'always dithering and slytherin' and replace it with the exact text 'ravenclaw and slytherin for life'. Preserve all existing styling, className attributes, and typography. Do not modify the 🥺 emoji or any other text content. Ensure the replacement text maintains consistent formatting with the Slytherin/Harry Potter magical theme.
